content: The dice of God are always loaded. Cause and effect, means and ends, seed and fruit, cannot be severed.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: Universal law cannot be cheated. The quality of your intentions and efforts contains the inevitable seeds of their future harvest.
practicalInsight: Focus entirely on planting healthy, honest seeds today; let the harvest take care of itself.
reflectionPrompt: What seeds of effort or neglect are you currently planting in your daily habits?
